description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to be used as a bike store for eight cycles; erection of a rear roof extension to the existing habitable office space and the formation of a pitched roof with slate covering in place of the existing flat roof to the three storey rear element of the building
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (FDC/20/14/08a; FDC/20/14/09a; FDC/20/14/10a  Received: 12 October 2020;  FDC/20/14/01; FDC/20/14/02; FDC/20/14/03; FDC/20/14/04; FDC/20/14/05; FDC/20/14/06; FDC/20/14/07; FDC/20/14/11; FDC/20/14/12  Received:  02 October 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the submitted plans the single storey rear extension shall be used as an employee cycle store incidental to the use of the offices on site and shall be equipped with four Sheffield stands each separated by one metre to provide parking for eight cycles before it is brought into use and shall be kept permanently available for that purpose.  The Sheffield stands shall be installed in accordance with the TFL London Cycling Design Standards.  No other form of cycle stand shall be installed.
